test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct option is:** 3) salting.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank requires a **noun **that describes the action of adding salt to food.
 
• The** gerund form "salting" **is the appropriate choice here because it functions as a noun to refer to the action or process of salting food more sparingly.

The correct sentence is: *"**Salting **__food more sparingly is linked to a lower risk of heart disease, heart failure, and ischemic heart disease."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

Why the other options are incorrect:

 
• **Option 1: "salt"** – This is the base form of the verb and does not work as a noun in this context. The sentence needs a noun (gerund) to describe the action.
 
• **Option 2: "salted"** – This is the past participle of "salt" and would typically be used to describe something already salted (an adjective). It does not fit grammatically here, as the sentence requires a noun for the action of salting.
 
• **Option 4: "salt with"** – This is a prepositional phrase, which is not needed here. The sentence requires a noun (gerund) to represent the action of salting, not a verb phrase.
